definition: Was strongly criticised or condemned by many people.
author: Jane Austen
quote: Although our productions have afforded more extensive and unaffected pleasure than those of any other literary corporation in the world, no species of composition has been so much decried.
example_sentence: Critics decried the remake as a pale copy.
